title: 复购率
question: 上个月各区域复购率同比
sql:
SELECT
  t.period AS period,
  t.region AS region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_buyers,
  COUNT(*) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    4
  ) AS repurchase_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id AS customer_id,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
      THEN '2026-09'
      ELSE '2025-09'
    END AS period,
    r.region_name AS region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_in_period
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN regions AS r
    ON o.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2025-09-30'
    )
  GROUP BY
    o.customer_id,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
      THEN '2026-09'
      ELSE '2025-09'
    END,
    r.region_name
) AS t
GROUP BY
  t.period,
  t.region
ORDER BY
  period,
  region
LIMIT 1000
